name: Tool — SharePoint (OBO)
summary: SharepointPreviewTool with OAuth on-behalf-of, attached to a BYOM-routed agent.
description: `SharepointPreviewTool` connects a Prompt Agent to SharePoint grounding through a configured connection while the orchestrator model is BYOM-routed. This lets users answer from SharePoint content using a gateway-hosted model.
notes:
Verified end-to-end with `SharepointPreviewTool` when `SHAREPOINT_CONNECTION_ID` is configured. See `test.py`.

SharePoint Grounding is on the official BYOM-supported tools list. Known limitation preserved: the OBO flow does not work when the agent is published to Teams.
